verdicts.evidence: The npm whoami result is returned as collected data, with Unknown substituted on failure (s1, f1:29). It populates npmUser and is sent through pingBack without a decision on its value (f1:68, f1:92, f1:102).

The whoami result is returned as collected data, with Unknown substituted on failure (s2, f1:38). It populates whoamiUser and is sent through pingBack without a decision on its value (f1:67, f1:92, f1:102).

The try/catch only selects the whoami string or the fallback Unknown for the collected whoamiUser field (s3, f1:67). Both outcomes continue through collectData to the same pingBack call, so this is collection error handling rather than an environment gate (f1:91, f1:102).
